title: Settlement Basis, Deposit Percentage and Accepted Payment Methods by Fulfilment Service
content:
Each fulfilment service of Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment carries its own settlement figures. The capture
basis states when the money is taken. The deposit percentage is the deposit taken when the order is placed, as a
percentage of the order total. The methods column states the ways the order may be paid for.

| Fulfilment service | When the money is taken | Deposit on placement, percent of the order total | Ways the order may be paid for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Parcel Delivery | in full when the order is placed | 100 | card, store credit or a financing account |
| Store Pickup Hold | in full when the order is placed | 100 | card, store credit or a financing account |
| Threshold Delivery | in full when the order is placed | 100 | card, store credit or a financing account |
| Room of Choice Delivery with Haul Away | in full when the order is placed | 100 | card, store credit or a financing account |
| White Glove Delivery and Installation | a deposit when placed and the balance on delivery | 25 | card, store credit or a financing account |
| Business Dock and Freight Delivery | on invoice after delivery | 0 | business invoice or bank transfer |

## The deposit percentage worked through (hypothetical order total)

The deposit percentage is taken on the order total. On White Glove Delivery and Installation, whose percentage is 25,
an order total of 4000.00 gives a deposit of 1000.00 on placement and leaves 3000.00 as the balance. On the four
services whose percentage is 100 the whole of the same order total is taken on placement and no balance remains. On
Business Dock and Freight Delivery the percentage is 0, so nothing is taken on placement.

## Notes on the methods column

Five of the six services accept card, store credit or a financing account. Business Dock and Freight Delivery accepts
business invoice or bank transfer, and is the one service whose money is taken on invoice after delivery.
